test_access_instructions: Open the test route with no login or token. It provides a fixed read-only live Airtable plan for ci-practice-v3, the restricted received-action evidence route, and links to the skill ZIP, instructions, expected output and TEST_EVIDENCE.md. It cannot import, authorise, dispatch or access another namespace.
known_limitations: Airtable, Make and the dedicated Gmail inbox require the privately supplied reviewer access; no credentials are stored in GitHub.
The Make delivery scenario uses a fixed dedicated test inbox and intentionally refuses recipient addresses supplied by callers.

The submitted delivery receipt was verified in the actual Gmail inbox and recorded through the review-authenticated manual confirmation route. The token-protected callback route for an automatic Make inbox watcher is implemented, but a separate watcher scenario is not currently configured.
